parsed_json.up_exec: Return all distinct IC50 activity rows (in nM) against human Aurora kinase A (CHEMBL4722, SINGLE PROTEIN, Homo sapiens). For each row include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows that have a canonical SMILES and at least one of pubmed_id or doi.
